executive_summary: Across FY26, Nazara delivered a sharp pivot toward a higher-quality, IP-led gaming platform, with EBITDA growth (FY26 +66%) materially outpacing revenue growth (+13%), driven by deconsolidation of volatile businesses (NODWIN), scaling of core gaming IPs, and operating leverage from Centers of Excellence (COEs). Management consistently emphasized disciplined capital allocation, margin expansion, and IP ownership, and largely delivered on margin improvement, though revenue visibility in some segments (Sportskeeda, AdTech, PokerBaazi) remained uneven. Strategic acquisitions (Curve earlier, Bluetile/BestPlay late FY26) meaningfully upgraded the platform, but added integration and execution complexity. Overall, the year reflects improving earnings quality and strategic clarity, tempered by recurring execution risks in non-core and platform-dependent businesses.

evidence: Q1FY26: Management framed results as 'early benefits of our sharpened focus on owning and scaling high quality gaming IPs' with clear articulation of COEs and profitability focus.
Q2FY26: On Freaks4U and Moonshine impairments, management emphasized conservative accounting: 'if we make a mistake, we should recognize it quickly and move ahead' (Q2FY26).
Q3FY26: Nitish explicitly acknowledged revenue decline due to NODWIN deconsolidation while highlighting margin expansion and refocus on higher-margin businesses (Q3FY26 opening remarks).
Q4FY26: Tone turned confident and forward-looking, stating FY26 'fundamentally changed the shape of Nazara' with gaming contributing 90% of EBITDA (Q4FY26 opening remarks).

guidance_vs_delivery.what_was_promised: Core gaming growth of ~20–25% YoY with EBITDA margins of 20–25% over time (management commentary).
guidance_vs_delivery.what_was_delivered: FY26 gaming EBITDA margin reached 24.7% and gaming EBITDA grew 157% YoY (Q4FY26 results).

guidance_vs_delivery.what_was_promised: Kiddopia subscriber stabilization with return to growth in 1–2 quarters.
guidance_vs_delivery.what_was_delivered: Kiddopia returned to subscriber growth in Q3FY26 and sustained growth in Q4FY26.

guidance_vs_delivery.what_was_promised: Target of ₹300 Cr EBITDA by FY27.
guidance_vs_delivery.what_was_delivered: FY26 EBITDA reached ₹255 Cr; FY27 target reiterated but not yet achieved.

topics.assessment: Management steadily delivered margin expansion broadly in line with stated targets.

guidance_evolution.pattern_summary: Management generally set realistic medium-term goals and tracked progress transparently. Where setbacks occurred (Sportskeeda, Freaks4U), guidance was revised openly rather than quietly deferred.

margin_commentary: Across quarters, management consistently emphasized margin improvement driven by IP ownership, disciplined UA, and COEs. Margins were pressured episodically by UA ramps (Fusebox, Kiddopia) and one-offs, but the narrative remained credible as margins expanded materially at group and gaming levels by FY26-end. Margin guidance avoided precise timelines, enhancing credibility.
revenue_growth_narrative: Revenue growth increasingly shifted from inorganic scale and volatile businesses to organic, IP-led growth across mobile, PC/console, and offline gaming. While headline revenue growth slowed post NODWIN deconsolidation, management consistently reframed focus toward quality, recurring, global IP monetization rather than absolute topline.
key_risks_flagged_by_management: Platform dependency on Apple/Google policies (Q1FY26, Q2FY26).
Google algorithm changes impacting Sportskeeda traffic (Q1FY26 onward).
Regulatory uncertainty in real-money gaming affecting Moonshine/PokerBaazi (Q2FY26).
Execution and monetization risk in new IP launches (Fusebox, Curve) (multiple quarters).
positive_signals: FY26 EBITDA grew 66% YoY with margin expansion to 13.9% (Q4FY26).
Gaming EBITDA contribution rose from 56% to 90% YoY (Q4FY26).
Kiddopia subscriber growth resumed after prolonged decline (Q3FY26).
Human Fall Flat crossed 58 million lifetime units (Q3FY26, Q4FY26).
Bluetile & BestPlay acquisition significantly expanded casual gaming scale (Q4FY26).
red_flags: Repeated reliance on Google algorithm recovery for Sportskeeda with limited visibility (Q1–Q4FY26).
Significant impairments in Freaks4U and Moonshine highlighting M&A risk (Q2FY26).
PokerBaazi losses offsetting associate profits quarter after quarter (Q1–Q3FY26).

business_problems_and_challenges.problem: Heavy dependence on third-party platforms (Google search, app stores) creates volatility in traffic and monetization.
business_problems_and_challenges.evidence: Sportskeeda traffic declined sharply after Google core updates; management expects recovery but with uncertainty (Q1FY26, Q3FY26).

business_problems_and_challenges.problem: User acquisition efficiency needs constant optimization to balance growth and margins.
business_problems_and_challenges.evidence: Margins dipped in Kiddopia and Fusebox due to higher UA spends, requiring COE intervention (Q1FY26, Q3FY26).

overall_investment_signal: cautious_positive: Strong improvement in earnings quality, margins, and strategic clarity, but lingering risks in non-core segments and platform dependence warrant measured optimism.

earnings_guidance.basis: Management reiterated target for FY27 driven by gaming scale and COEs.

capex_plans.item: Offline gaming center expansion (Funky Monkeys, Smaaash 2.0)

mergers_and_acquisitions.strategic_rationale: Expand casual gaming scale and add AI-native capabilities.
mergers_and_acquisitions.financial_impact: CY25 revenue ₹1,460 Cr, EBITDA ₹254 Cr (management disclosed)
